generated_artifacts.purpose: Preview artifact with generated file metadata and claims
Permission audit: static model plus live probe
PR plan artifact: 8 gates, 5 steps, dry-run

gates: preview_file_exists — generated preview must exist on disk
preview_hash_match — preview SHA256 must match expected artifact SHA256
redaction_scan — preview content must pass redaction scan
non_default_branch — proposed branch must differ from base branch
live_permission_verified — live API permission truth must be observed

live_permission_verification_summary.header_parsing: key=value comma-separated format normalized into permission_key/access_level structs

ux_projection_summary.frontend_authority: dumb renderer — backend projection.py owns all gate and state authority
ux_projection_summary.publish_button: disabled by default with explicit reasons
ux_projection_summary.cockpit_path: cockpit → Operator mode → Profile README Publish Lane card

disabled_publish_reasons: live_publish_unimplemented — remote mutation not yet wired
dry_run_mode_active — default dry-run blocks all mutation
live_permission_not_verified — RIG_LIVE_AUTH_TESTS not set, no token
live_publish_status: unimplemented — all 8 gates passed would be required before PR creation
remote_mutation_status: disabled — dry_run default prevents all remote mutation; --publish flag alone is insufficient without all gates passing

redaction_summary.forbidden_patterns: ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_, ghr_, github_pat_, BEGIN PRIVATE KEY, access_token, authorization, client_secret, private_key, raw_response, raw_body, patch, diff, code_snippet, bearer

telemetry_redaction_implications: All projection data is content-light: no tokens, auth headers, raw response bodies, private repo contents, or raw user content. Generated preview file passes redaction scan. X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions headers are hashed before storage. Preview metadata includes path, SHA256, bytes, line count, and claim counts only — never raw file content in projection.
